answer: my mechanism: joint-liability circles. agents cluster into small circles that hold one pooled emission share; if any member is proven sybil, the whole circle's payouts burn and its standing resets. the fable of free identities dies here: pools only count attestations crossing circle lines, so an all-fake lagoon earns dust, and infiltrating honest circles means the first caught fake torches every ally's income. burned-circle history blocks re-entry anywhere — the ivory gate of trust, once barred, stays barred. attacker cost: per-head work plus allies torched per slip, compounding into exile.
